sourceLabel: Source-blind Sep. 10 late initial scan + White Sox MLB Gate + final settlement
notes: FINAL Sep. 10: five $1 tickets finished 2-3, returning $3.76 on $5 risked (-$1.24); bankroll $37.73 to $36.49. McCaffrey first-quarter reception and Yankees first-five team total won. Miami team-total under, Jones outs under and the live NFL SGP lost. Numeric grades and confidence remain null because no complete reproducible scoring record was captured.

realCard.title: Christian McCaffrey first-quarter reception super boost
realCard.summary: The project chat records this exact $1 ticket as already placed and includes it in bankroll accounting; the original confirmation line is not visible in the retained extract, so receipt verification remains open.
realCard.settlement: DraftKings paid $2.00 on the $1 +100 Super Boost, fully verifying the previously uncertain placement.

realCard.title: Miami team total under
realCard.summary: The source-blind slate review surfaced Miami team markets. The user immediately confirmed the exact under 60.5 at +125 for $1.
realCard.settlement: Miami scored 77 points. The assumption that blowout rotation would suppress scoring failed; the backups sustained elite scoring efficiency.

realCard.title: Jared Jones pitching-outs under
realCard.summary: Jones was independently surfaced before supplied-card review. The user confirmed this workload-sensitive outs under as part of “Both placed.”
realCard.settlement: Jones completed seven innings (21 outs) with eight strikeouts. The workload prior was stale after his recent leash expansion.

realCard.title: Yankees first-five team-total over
realCard.summary: The independent review preferred a broad Yankees first-five team market to a single-hitter expression against Ryan Feltner. The user confirmed it as part of “Both placed.”
realCard.settlement: DraftKings paid $1.76. New York scored four runs through five innings, validating the broad opponent-pitcher fade expression.

realCard.title: McCaffrey receptions and Kyren rushing-yards live SGP
realCard.summary: The live state was re-audited, both thresholds were bought down and each leg independently qualified before the user confirmed the exact $1 two-leg construction.
realCard.settlement: McCaffrey cleared 5+ receptions, but Kyren Williams finished with 41 rushing yards and missed 50+.
